component.name: Flowsurface
component.summary: Crypto market charts and order-flow analysis

description.p: Flowsurface is a native desktop charting platform for crypto markets. It brings together live trades, order books and candle data from supported exchanges in heatmap, candlestick, footprint, time-and-sales and depth ladder views.
Layouts, chart presets, themes and indicators can be customized. Optional historical trade backfill is available from Binance or a compatible server, and trade streams can play sound effects.
Sound effects are optional and disabled by default. To enable audio output, run flatpak override --user --socket=pulseaudio io.github.flowsurface_rs.Flowsurface.
Added scriptable indicators, TPO and volume profile studies, a rewritten candlestick chart, multi-ticker time and sales, and chart presets.
